sentences: Three hunters trudge down a hill with their worn-out dogs.
All they have to show for the day is one scrawny fox, so the hunt has mostly failed.
Outside the inn on the left, villagers have lit a fire to singe a pig, and far below on the frozen ponds, tiny figures skate and play.
Bruegel starts the view right behind the hunters' backs and sweeps it diagonally down across the whole valley, toward jagged peaks that no Flemish landscape ever had.
The panel is thought to belong to a series of the seasons made for the Antwerp merchant Niclaes Jongelinck, and five of the six paintings survive.
It holds a hard winter and the stubborn rhythm of everyday life in one frame.
